episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: So people watch a billion hours a day on YouTube, I believe.
So 500 hours of video every minute.
Watching just one day's new uploads would take over 82 years.
Well, this is the 20 million videos uploaded a day.
I bet you now that so many people are posting, you know, shorts, it's probably like way higher now.
But I mean, but what we're talking about, like having a platform like that where anybody can upload anything, it just makes the variety so intense.
Like there's anything you want to watch, any video you want to watch on nature, any video you want to watch on you have a question about science, just put it in there.
And there's some guy who's got a fucking one and a half hour lecture on it.
And that's the beauty to tie everything together as like a bow.
That's why you can learn anything and you can do anything you want for a living for the most part if you allocate the time because it's all there.
